method_notes: Newham LA Determined Admission Arrangements (Sept 2027 entry, printed in the 'Starting school in September 2027' booklet pp59-80), adopted by all Newham community, VC, academy and free schools except Harris Academy Chobham and the Catholic/CofE VA faith schools. Tie-break within each criterion is shortest home-to-school walking distance, calculated by an industry GIS in miles to 3 decimal places. Start: the address point in the Council's Local Land and Property Gazetteer (LLPG; blocks of flats use the block's point), joined by a 'dogleg' to the nearest point of the OS MasterMap Highways Network. End: the school's nominated entrance, i.e. the main gate at the official postal address unless the governing body notifies another (p79: Central Park Primary - Loxford Avenue E6; St Joachim's RC Primary - Front Main Entrance of Newham Dockside). Route uses adopted highways and approved footpaths; excludes parks (the Greenway is included), unofficial crossings of A-roads and the DLR, Royal Docks crossings other than official bridges, and commercial/residential car parks. Out-of-borough applicants: straight line from the nearest highway point to the borough boundary, then walking. Equal distances: lower floor in flats first, otherwise random draw. Booklet notes some academies that do not adopt these arrangements use straight-line distance or random allocation; Harris Academy Chobham's offer table gives its tie-break as straight-line distance. The Catholic schools and St Luke's CofE use shortest walking distance.

gaps: Newham's tables print 'N/A' for both criterion and distance whenever a school did not fill on time; these are recorded as all_offered (the table shows fewer on-time offers than places). Shaftesbury 2026, Stratford Manor 2026/2025, Earlham 2024, St Antony's 2024, St Joachim's 2025 and St Francis' 2026 were full (or over) but still show N/A, with the last places going to LA alternative allocations, so they are also treated as all_offered: an inference. Ellen Wilkinson 2024 (56 of 60) and Kensington 2024 (69 of 90) print a distance although the totals show spare places; the distances are kept as printed. St Helen's 2024 and St Winefride's 2024 last offers were under faith criterion 'FPG9' (as printed). The St Luke's 2025 total was not transcribed. Excluded: Calverton Primary (closed 31 Aug 2026) and Odessa Infant (closed 31 Aug 2026 when it merged into St James' CofE), plus junior schools Godwin and Lathom. St James' CofE Primary (VC, E7 9DA) became an all-through primary from Sept 2026 by absorbing Odessa Infant, so it has no reception offer history under its own name; it is recorded as not_published. Odessa's own tables showed all applicants offered in 2026 (44 of 60), 2025 (26 of 60) and 2024 (47 of 90). PAN is the 'Actual Places' for Sept 2026 (published admission numbers can be higher). Postcodes and types come from GIAS (Oct 2026). For academies we assumed they adopt the LA's walking method, as the booklet states; individual academy policies were not read. The 2026 tables are spread over facing pages and were matched by row order, with the totals checked against places.
